column4: Historical attempts without retained APK evidence are labeled accordingly, without claiming that no temporary APK ever existed.
Importing older APK history no longer places an older build ahead of a newer failed attempt in the same numbering family.
Added a permanent regression check for preserving build-number order while importing missing compiled histories.
The Android highlight capture now waits for a rendered frame instead of capturing the preceding frame immediately after selection.
Recorded successful TEST72 checks, owner-approved hidden-trap behavior and the corrected visual capture in the report and handoff.
I kept missing-artifact labels precise and corrected imported build ordering. I also tightened the Android screenshot timing for the stair highlight.
